fullText.simplified:
第十九章、家国精神

    在河边，和老人说完话以后，伤心的我一步一步，走向了河里……
    后来发生的事情，我不记得了。听人们说，五月五日那天，我死在了南方的一条大河里。听到消息，那些被我扶过的百姓跑到河边，他们伤心地哭了。越来越多的百姓跑到河边，他们想找到我，但是河水太深，他们找不到我。于是，百姓们划着船，把米饭扔进河里。他们希望鱼儿吃米饭，不要吃我的身体。
    听到这些，我很感动。原来楚国的百姓一直记得我。我不是一个人，我还有他们。
    好了，我的故事到这里就结束了。谢谢你读完它。我知道这有点儿难，因为这段历史比较复杂。你能读到最后，真的很棒。我在故事开头说过，后人把我的理想当成中国“家国精神”的重要组成部分。现在，你大概明白“家国精神”这个词的意思了吧？它其实就是“爱自己的家，爱自己的国，并愿意为它们努力”的意思。
    我是在五月五日离开这个世界的。五月五日就是中国的“端午节”。在端午节，中国人会划龙船、吃粽子，都是为了纪念我。粽子就是从以前百姓扔到河里的米饭发展而来的。
    中国历史上有很多优秀的人，我不知道为什么人们特别记得我。我听过一种说法，我想告诉你。
    这种说法是：现在的世界很好，人们都知道什么是好国家，也知道用什么样的标准来管理国家。但在2300多年前，人们对国家的认识还很简单。虽然大家接受由王来管理国家，但王应该用什么样的方法来管理国家，还没有人说得清楚。我的理想里有一个重要的组成部分，后人把它叫做“美政”，意思是用正确的、为百姓好的方法，来管理国家。我提出的“美政”是一种好的标准，以后所有的王都要用它来管理国家。它就像高地上的明灯，照亮了后世中国前进的道路。
    这种说法是我以前没有想到的。我很高兴，因为现在的人们比我们那时候懂得更多。你们的世界比我的世界更好。我很高兴你们能生活在这样的世界里。祝你们每天都生活得快乐而有理想。
fullText.traditional:
第十九章、家國精神

    在河邊，和老人說完話以後，傷心的我一步一步，走向了河裡……
    後來發生的事情，我不記得了。聽人們說，五月五日那天，我死在了南方的一條大河裡。聽到消息，那些被我扶過的百姓跑到河邊，他們傷心地哭了。越來越多的百姓跑到河邊，他們想找到我，但是河水太深，他們找不到我。於是，百姓們划著船，把米飯扔進河裡。他們希望魚兒吃米飯，不要吃我的身體。
    聽到這些，我很感動。原來楚國的百姓一直記得我。我不是一個人，我還有他們。
    好了，我的故事到這裡就結束了。謝謝你讀完它。我知道這有點兒難，因為這段歷史比較複雜。你能讀到最後，真的很棒。我在故事開頭說過，後人把我的理想當成中國“家國精神”的重要組成部分。現在，你大概明白“家國精神”這個詞的意思了吧？它其實就是“愛自己的家，愛自己的國，並願意為它們努力”的意思。
    我是在五月五日離開這個世界的。五月五日就是中國的“端午節”。在端午節，中國人會划龍船、吃粽子，都是為了紀念我。粽子就是從以前百姓扔到河裡的米飯發展而來的。
    中國歷史上有很多優秀的人，我不知道為什麼人們特別記得我。我聽過一種說法，我想告訴你。
    這種說法是：現在的世界很好，人們都知道什麼是好國家，也知道用什麼樣的標準來管理國家。但在2300多年前，人們對國家的認識還很簡單。雖然大家接受由王來管理國家，但王應該用什麼樣的方法來管理國家，還沒有人說得清楚。我的理想裡有一個重要的組成部分，後人把它叫做“美政”，意思是用正確的、為百姓好的方法，來管理國家。我提出的“美政”是一種好的標準，以後所有的王都要用它來管理國家。它就像高地上的明燈，照亮了後世中國前進的道路。
    這種說法是我以前沒有想到的。我很高興，因為現在的人們比我們那時候懂得更多。你們的世界比我的世界更好。我很高興你們能生活在這樣的世界裡。祝你們每天都生活得快樂而有理想。

sentences.pinyin: zài hé biān hé lǎo rén shuō wán huà yǐ hòu shāng xīn de wǒ yí bù yí bù zǒu xiàng le hé lǐ
sentences.english: By the river, after talking with the old man, I, heartbroken, walked step by step into the river …

sentences.simplified: 后来发生的事情，我不记得了。听人们说，五月五日那天，我死在了南方的一条大河里。
sentences.traditional: 後來發生的事情，我不記得了。聽人們說，五月五日那天，我死在了南方的一條大河裡。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái fā shēng de shì qing wǒ bú jì de le tīng rén men shuō wǔ yuè wǔ rì nà tiān wǒ sǐ zài le nán fāng de yì tiáo dà hé lǐ
sentences.english: I don’t remember what happened afterward. People say that on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, I died in a great river in the south.

sentences.simplified: 听到消息，那些被我扶过的百姓跑到河边，他们伤心地哭了。
sentences.traditional: 聽到消息，那些被我扶過的百姓跑到河邊，他們傷心地哭了。
sentences.pinyin: tīng dào xiāo xi nà xiē bèi wǒ fú guò de bǎi xìng pǎo dào hé biān tā men shāng xīn de kū le
sentences.english: Upon hearing the news, the people I had helped ran to the riverbank, crying in sorrow.

sentences.simplified: 越来越多的百姓跑到河边，他们想找到我，但是河水太深，他们找不到我。
sentences.traditional: 越來越多的百姓跑到河邊，他們想找到我，但是河水太深，他們找不到我。
sentences.pinyin: yuè lái yuè duō de bǎi xìng pǎo dào hé biān tā men xiǎng zhǎo dào wǒ dàn shì hé shuǐ tài shēn tā men zhǎo bú dào wǒ
sentences.english: More and more people came to the riverbank, hoping to find me, but the river was too deep, and they couldn’t find me.

sentences.simplified: 于是，百姓们划着船，把米饭扔进河里。他们希望鱼儿吃米饭，不要吃我的身体。
sentences.traditional: 於是，百姓們划著船，把米飯扔進河裡。他們希望魚兒吃米飯，不要吃我的身體。
sentences.pinyin: yú shì bǎi xìng men huá zhe chuán bǎ mǐ fàn rēng jìn hé lǐ tā men xī wàng yú'r chī mǐ fàn bú yào chī wǒ de shēn tǐ
sentences.english: So the people rowed their boats and threw rice into the river. They hoped the fish would eat the rice instead of my body.

sentences.simplified: 听到这些，我很感动。原来楚国的百姓一直记得我。我不是一个人，我还有他们。
sentences.traditional: 聽到這些，我很感動。原來楚國的百姓一直記得我。我不是一個人，我還有他們。
sentences.pinyin: tīng dào zhè xiē wǒ hěn gǎn dòng yuán lái chǔ guó de bǎi xìng yì zhí jì de wǒ wǒ bú shì yí ge rén wǒ hái yǒu tā men
sentences.english: When I heard this, I was deeply moved. It turned out that the people of Chu had always remembered me. I was not alone. I still had them.

sentences.simplified: 好了，我的故事到这里就结束了。谢谢你读完它。我知道这有点儿难，因为这段历史比较复杂。
sentences.traditional: 好了，我的故事到這裡就結束了。謝謝你讀完它。我知道這有點兒難，因為這段歷史比較複雜。
sentences.pinyin: hǎo le wǒ de gù shi dào zhè lǐ jiù jié shù le xiè xie nǐ dú wán tā wǒ zhī dào zhè yǒu diǎn'r nán yīn wèi zhè duàn lì shǐ bǐ jiào fù zá
sentences.english: Well, my story ends here. Thank you for reading it. I know it’s a bit difficult because this part of history is quite complex.

sentences.simplified: 你能读到最后，真的很棒。
sentences.traditional: 你能讀到最後，真的很棒。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ néng dú dào zuì hòu zhēn de hěn bàng
sentences.english: It’s really great that you were able to read to the end.

sentences.simplified: 我在故事开头说过，
sentences.traditional: 我在故事開頭說過，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zài gù shi kāi tóu shuō guò
sentences.english: As I mentioned at the beginning of the story, ..

sentences.simplified: 后人把我的理想当成中国“家国精神”的重要组成部分。
sentences.traditional: 後人把我的理想當成中國“家國精神”的重要組成部分。
sentences.pinyin: hòu rén bǎ wǒ de lǐ xiǎng dāng chéng zhōng guó jiā guó jīng shén de zhòng yào zǔ chéng bù fen
sentences.english: .. later generations regarded my ideals as an important part of China’s “spirit of home and country”.

sentences.simplified: 现在，你大概明白“家国精神”这个词的意思了吧？
sentences.traditional: 現在，你大概明白“家國精神”這個詞的意思了吧？
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài nǐ dà gài míng bai jiā guó jīng shén zhè ge cí de yì si le ba
sentences.english: Now, you probably have a rough understanding of what the term “spirit of home and country” means, right?

sentences.simplified: 它其实就是“爱自己的家，爱自己的国，并愿意为它们努力”的意思。
sentences.traditional: 它其實就是“愛自己的家，愛自己的國，並願意為它們努力”的意思。
sentences.pinyin: tā qí shí jiù shì ài zì jǐ de jiā ài zì jǐ de guó bìng yuàn yì wèi tā men nǔ lì de yì si
sentences.english: It actually means “loving your home, loving your country, and being willing to strive for them”.

sentences.simplified: 我是在五月五日离开这个世界的。
sentences.traditional: 我是在五月五日離開這個世界的。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ shì zài wǔ yuè wǔ rì lí kāi zhè ge shì jiè de
sentences.english: I left this world on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month.

sentences.simplified: 五月五日就是中国的“端午节”。
sentences.traditional: 五月五日就是中國的“端午節”。
sentences.pinyin: wǔ yuè wǔ rì jiù shì zhōng guó de duān wǔ jié
sentences.english: The fifth day of the fifth lunar month is China’s “Dragon Boat Festival”.

sentences.simplified: 在端午节，中国人会划龙船、吃粽子，都是为了纪念我。
sentences.traditional: 在端午節，中國人會划龍船、吃粽子，都是為了紀念我。
sentences.pinyin: zài duān wǔ jié zhōng guó rén huì huá lóng chuán chī zòng zi dōu shì wèi le jì niàn wǒ
sentences.english: During the Dragon Boat Festival, Chinese people row dragon boats and eat zongzi, all to commemorate me.

sentences.simplified: 粽子就是从以前百姓扔到河里的米饭发展而来的。
sentences.traditional: 粽子就是從以前百姓扔到河裡的米飯發展而來的。
sentences.pinyin: zòng zi jiù shì cóng yǐ qián bǎi xìng rēng dào hé lǐ de mǐ fàn fā zhǎn ér lái de
sentences.english: Zongzi developed from the rice that the people had thrown into the river.

sentences.simplified: 中国历史上有很多优秀的人，我不知道为什么人们特别记得我。
sentences.traditional: 中國歷史上有很多優秀的人，我不知道為什麼人們特別記得我。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó lì shǐ shang yǒu hěn duō yōu xiù de rén wǒ bù zhī dào wèi shén me rén men tè bié jì de wǒ
sentences.english: There have been many outstanding people in Chinese history, and I don’t know why people particularly remember me.

sentences.simplified: 我听过一种说法，我想告诉你。
sentences.traditional: 我聽過一種說法，我想告訴你。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ tīng guò yì zhǒng shuō fa wǒ xiǎng gào su nǐ
sentences.english: I have heard an explanation that I want to share with you.

sentences.simplified: 这种说法是：现在的世界很好，
sentences.traditional: 這種說法是：現在的世界很好，
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhǒng shuō fa shì xiàn zài de shì jiè hěn hǎo
sentences.english: This explanation is that the world today is very good.

sentences.simplified: 人们都知道什么是好国家，也知道用什么样的标准来管理国家。
sentences.traditional: 人們都知道什麼是好國家，也知道用什麼樣的標準來管理國家。
sentences.pinyin: rén men dōu zhī dào shén me shì hǎo guó jiā yě zhī dào yòng shén me yàng de biāo zhǔn lái guǎn lǐ guó jiā
sentences.english: People know what a good country is, and they know what standards to govern a country by.

sentences.simplified: 但在2300多年前，人们对国家的认识还很简单。
sentences.traditional: 但在2300多年前，人們對國家的認識還很簡單。
sentences.pinyin: dàn zài 4 duō nián qián rén men duì guó jiā de rèn shi hái hěn jiǎn dān
sentences.english: But more than 2,300 years ago, people’s understanding of a country was still simple.

sentences.simplified: 虽然大家接受由王来管理国家，但王应该用什么样的方法来管理国家，还没有人说得清楚。
sentences.traditional: 雖然大家接受由王來管理國家，但王應該用什麼樣的方法來管理國家，還沒有人說得清楚。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán dà jiā jiē shòu yóu wáng lái guǎn lǐ guó jiā dàn wáng yīng gāi yòng shén me yàng de fāng fǎ lái guǎn lǐ guó jiā hái méi yǒu rén shuō de qīng chu
sentences.english: Although everyone accepted that the king should govern the country, no one had clearly articulated what methods the king should use.

sentences.simplified: 我的理想里有一个重要的组成部分，后人把它叫做“美政”，
sentences.traditional: 我的理想裡有一個重要的組成部分，後人把它叫做“美政”，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de lǐ xiǎng lǐ yǒu yí ge zhòng yào de zǔ chéng bù fen hòu rén bǎ tā jiào zuò měi zhèng
sentences.english: An important part of my ideals, which later generations called “benevolent governance”, ..

sentences.simplified: 意思是用正确的、为百姓好的方法，来管理国家。
sentences.traditional: 意思是用正確的、為百姓好的方法，來管理國家。
sentences.pinyin: yì si shì yòng zhèng què de wèi bǎi xìng hǎo de fāng fǎ lái guǎn lǐ guó jiā
sentences.english: .. was using correct methods that benefit the people to govern a country.

sentences.simplified: 我提出的“美政”是一种好的标准，以后所有的王都要用它来管理国家。
sentences.traditional: 我提出的“美政”是一種好的標準，以後所有的王都要用它來管理國家。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ tí chū de měi zhèng shì yì zhǒng hǎo de biāo zhǔn yǐ hòu suǒ yǒu de wáng dōu yào yòng tā lái guǎn lǐ guó jiā
sentences.english: The “benevolent governance” I proposed was a good standard, and all future kings would have to follow it in governing their nations.

sentences.simplified: 它就像高地上的明灯，照亮了后世中国前进的道路。
sentences.traditional: 它就像高地上的明燈，照亮了後世中國前進的道路。
sentences.pinyin: tā jiù xiàng gāo dì shang de míng dēng zhào liàng le hòu shì zhōng guó qián jìn de dào lù
sentences.english: It was like a beacon on high ground, illuminating the path for future generations of China.

sentences.simplified: 这种说法是我以前没有想到的。
sentences.traditional: 這種說法是我以前沒有想到的。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhǒng shuō fa shì wǒ yǐ qián méi yǒu xiǎng dào de
sentences.english: This explanation was something I hadn’t thought of before.

sentences.simplified: 我很高兴，因为现在的人们比我们那时候懂得更多。
sentences.traditional: 我很高興，因為現在的人們比我們那時候懂得更多。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hěn gāo xìng yīn wèi xiàn zài de rén men bǐ wǒ men nà shí hou dǒng de gèng duō
sentences.english: I am very happy because people now understand more than we did back then.

sentences.simplified: 你们的世界比我的世界更好。我很高兴你们能生活在这样的世界里。
sentences.traditional: 你們的世界比我的世界更好。我很高興你們能生活在這樣的世界裡。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ men de shì jiè bǐ wǒ de shì jiè gèng hǎo wǒ hěn gāo xìng nǐ men néng shēng huó zài zhè yàng de shì jiè lǐ
sentences.english: Your world is better than mine was. I’m glad that you can live in such a world.

sentences.simplified: 祝你们每天都生活得快乐而有理想。
sentences.traditional: 祝你們每天都生活得快樂而有理想。
sentences.pinyin: zhù nǐ men měi tiān dōu shēng huó de kuài lè ér yǒu lǐ xiǎng
sentences.english: I wish you a life filled with happiness and ideals every day.

sentence_translations: Chapter 19: The Spirit of Home and Country
By the river, after talking with the old man, I, heartbroken, walked step by step into the river …
I don’t remember what happened afterward. People say that on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, I died in a great river in the south.
Upon hearing the news, the people I had helped ran to the riverbank, crying in sorrow.
More and more people came to the riverbank, hoping to find me, but the river was too deep, and they couldn’t find me.
So the people rowed their boats and threw rice into the river. They hoped the fish would eat the rice instead of my body.
When I heard this, I was deeply moved. It turned out that the people of Chu had always remembered me. I was not alone. I still had them.
Well, my story ends here. Thank you for reading it. I know it’s a bit difficult because this part of history is quite complex.
It’s really great that you were able to read to the end.
As I mentioned at the beginning of the story, ..
.. later generations regarded my ideals as an important part of China’s “spirit of home and country”.
Now, you probably have a rough understanding of what the term “spirit of home and country” means, right?
It actually means “loving your home, loving your country, and being willing to strive for them”.
I left this world on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month.
The fifth day of the fifth lunar month is China’s “Dragon Boat Festival”.
During the Dragon Boat Festival, Chinese people row dragon boats and eat zongzi, all to commemorate me.
Zongzi developed from the rice that the people had thrown into the river.
There have been many outstanding people in Chinese history, and I don’t know why people particularly remember me.
I have heard an explanation that I want to share with you.
This explanation is that the world today is very good.
People know what a good country is, and they know what standards to govern a country by.
But more than 2,300 years ago, people’s understanding of a country was still simple.
Although everyone accepted that the king should govern the country, no one had clearly articulated what methods the king should use.
An important part of my ideals, which later generations called “benevolent governance”, ..
.. was using correct methods that benefit the people to govern a country.
The “benevolent governance” I proposed was a good standard, and all future kings would have to follow it in governing their nations.
It was like a beacon on high ground, illuminating the path for future generations of China.
This explanation was something I hadn’t thought of before.
I am very happy because people now understand more than we did back then.
Your world is better than mine was. I’m glad that you can live in such a world.
I wish you a life filled with happiness and ideals every day.
